predeclaration: Separately versioned native PAN nodes/edges projection contract; distinct schema and version from the frozen relational projection-profile v1. No relational fields and no period metadata are introduced.
digestSemantics: The raw released artifact digest, the canonical transport digest, and the projection body digest are three separate verified bindings. The raw digest is the frozen released artifact bytes; the canonical transport digest is the canonical JSON wire form; the body digest is the projection self-attested digest over everything except projectionDigest. The raw artifact is a trusted sidecar pin, not re-derivable from incoming transport.
gateOrder: native v1 exact closed shape with frozen subject, authority, and coverage freeze
native source provenance attested against the trusted release sidecar
projection body self-digest and sidecar body pin
canonical transport digest equals the sidecar pin
